quotes.text: The metals are listed in descending order of value. This, in turn, determines their use for various objects; the closer the object is to the Holy of Holies, the more valuable the metal of which it is made. Iron is notably absent, either on account of its great rarity at this time or because its utilization for more efficient weapons of death made it incompatible with the spiritual ends that the sanctuary was intended to serve.
quotes.speaker: Nahum Sarna
quotes.attr: Nahum Sarna, The JPS Torah Commentary: Exodus, Philadelphia, 1989, 156

quotes.text: "For brass I will bring gold, and for iron I will bring silver, and for wood brass, and for stones iron.” — Isaiah lx. 17.
